situation: Bot was running on Hetzner but executing ZERO trades. All micro-cap gems were being rejected with scores of 20-35, well below the MIN_GEM_SCORE threshold of 50.
root_cause: Signal engine indicator fallbacks were set to 0 instead of 50 (neutral). When RSI, MACD, Bollinger, etc. returned None for new tokens with no price history, the weighted average collapsed to near-zero.
solution: Changed all indicator fallback values from 0 to 50 in signal_engine.py. Also added explicit None-handling with neutral defaults in each indicator function.
lesson: In a weighted average scoring system, missing data should contribute the neutral midpoint (50), not zero. Zero is not 'no data' — it's the worst possible score.

user_feedback.comments: Fixed the core issue — bot started trading immediately after deploy
